annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a Litecoin mining site with paid plans and daily earnings while directing viewers to choose a plan and recharge. The speaker instructs viewers to send 10 USDT to a generated address for faster mining, and the purchase page shows selectable plans, prices, daily-return figures, and a cryptocurrency payment destination awaiting payment. Although the description calls the material educational and includes an income caveat, the records do not verify actual returns, a completed transfer, or the payment recipient.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Selectable paid miner contracts are paired with daily-return figures. The speaker connects choosing and recharging an upgrade, including sending 10 USDT to an address, with faster mining. This is a paid-mining-income pitch, not evidence that any payment or return occurred.
